#Landlord.Face.Unhappy
Landlord: Oh, you finally decided to show up.
You: We accidentally meet on a staircase, you can’t expect any punctuality from me.
Landlord: Whatever. I have a new mission for you.
You: What is it?
Landlord: Here’s the thing. One of the tenants needs to go.
You: I’m not killing anyone.
Landlord: Eh… {{wi}}{{punch}}Shut up an listen!
Landlord: No one is killing anyone. That’s bad for business.
Landlord: By ‘I want him gone’ I meant that he needs to be forced out of his flat!
You: Why?
Landlord: At the end of the day, does it really matter?
You: I’m not some paid assassin.
Landlord: That old guy living at 14C is pissing me off. He’s been there forever and I can’t raise his rent. What’s worse, instead of giving me more money he’s paying a premium for the police! Can you believe that? Talk about supporting your community…
You: …
Landlord: His stubbornness is scaring away every land developer in the area that wants to level this place. 
Landlord: Anyway, my usual methods of hiring some tough guys and kicking him out won’t work. He has cops on speed dial. This needs to be settled with wits. I know it’s not your strong side, but I’m sure you will come up with something. {{wi}}Eventually.
Is he truly trying to stall me out? For what purpose? 
I will play along for now, but this is the last time I’m doing any side mission for him!
You: Fine. I will do it, but that will be the last time! After this we are going to the island!
Landlord: You, cheeky-! Fine!
Landlord: That tenant was giving me trouble for years, I wonder how you will manage this one. Good luck, buahahahaha!
